results.summary_before: This design computes the Henon map, a discrete-time chaotic dynamical system, in 10-bit signed Q2.8 fixed-point arithmetic. It serialises the resulting x and y samples as raw bit streams on separate output pins, each with its own enable and end-of-sequence flag, and asserts done_henon once the first valid sample is available. The documentation describes the three sub-blocks and the arithmetic format but the external hardware section is empty. It is a compact 1x1 implementation of a mathematical recurrence rather than a general-purpose processor.
